about: Marks read off body_turnaround for the skirt QA (charkit/skirtqa.py), in L on the design grid (x from the grid's origin, z from the eye line). flap_faces: per view, seeds inside each overskirt flap's face where it lies over the skirt: the outfit masks cut that face as the skirt (the same colour), and skirtqa fills it between the drawn lines (their gaps closed by close_px) and adds the outfit mask's tail. walls: segments [x0, z0, x1, z1] bridging a drawn line that fades out (the back's right flap's inner edge, z -1.60..-1.70). Read by eye on the design grid at 3-6x (tool/skirt, 2026-09-30).
